seg.seg_note: Four segments in 2009: Professional Instrumentation (test & measurement + environmental), Medical Technologies (dental + life sciences & diagnostics), Industrial Technologies, Tools & Components (+ Other = unallocated corporate). Segment sales/OP from 10-K Note 19 (in $000s, identical to release). Growth components from 10-K MD&A segment tables, labelled 'Existing businesses' (= core), 'Acquisitions', 'Currency exchange rates'; in this era the table is additive (existing + acquisitions + currency = total), so acq/fx are recorded as shown (acquisitions positive = added growth). Tools & Components row labelled 'Acquisition / Product line divestiture' (—). Total-company components from release 'Core Revenue Growth/Decline' table (core -12.0, acquisitions +2.0, currency -2.0, total -12.0). Segment depreciation and amortization only published combined (see extra.seg_extra.dep_amort); segment restructuring charges 2009: PI 99.0, MT 60.5, IT 60.7, T&C 18.3 (total 238.5; 121.8 in cost of sales, 116.7 in SG&A).

ngaap.notes: Adjusted net earnings / adjusted diluted EPS in this era exclude only items of inconsistent frequency: restructuring in excess of budget, acquisition transaction costs and inventory/deferred revenue fair value adjustments, the Align litigation gain and discrete tax items. Amortization of intangibles is NOT added back (amort_pretax null). Adjusted net earnings 1,177.2 (2008: 1,414.1). After-tax item amounts from the release reconciliation ($000s, rounded); pretax amounts from the item descriptions. Release gives no free cash flow table and no numeric 2010 guidance (only 'modest overall sales growth' expected in 10-K MD&A).
